en: Color-tinted historical postcard showing a large open square with carriages and pedestrians in front of a monumental arched gate flanked by buildings. On the right stands a tall clock/observation tower and another ornate building. The architecture is Ottoman-era. Printed caption text in French at the bottom left identifies the scene as the entrance and tower of the Seraskierat in Constantinople. A modern website watermark appears across the lower right.
